Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the

original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 4. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder should have experience in supply of stationery / office stationery items to Government Depar tments, PSUs, Autonomous bodies, Defense Establishments or other reputed organizations. The bidder s hall submit at least one relevant Contract Order / Work Order / Completion Certificate as proof of experien ce. 2. Uploading bid does not constitute / entail any guarantee for allotting / awarding any orders / contract, th e decision of the Accepting Officer / Buyer shall be final and binding in case of any disputes. 3. The bidder will be responsible for lifting of defective / rejected items supplied by him from consignee loc ation under his own arrangement and cost within 10 days after issue of notice of rejection. 4. Make of the items offered in the bid should be approved by E-in-C's Branch / Command Headquarters / Zonal Specifications in group one category. A copy of the same should be uploaded by the bidder. If the ap proval not uploaded by the bidder, the bid will be rejected. 5. The bidder shall submit an undertaking confirming that all information / documents submitted are genui ne and correct and that the bidder shall comply with all terms and conditions of the GeM bid. 6. Valid ISO certificate of the bidder's firm must be uploaded. 7. The bidder should upload affidavit for non-black listing by any department. 8. Payment of supply against bid items will be done only after completion of supply of all items mentioned i n the contract. 9. Bid will be rejected if any of the document / certificate as requested in GeM bid / ATC has not been uplo aded by the bidder. 10. The bidder must be registered under GST and shall submit a valid GST Registration Certificate with last financial year GST return. 11. All items supplied shall be brand new, unused and good of quality. 12. The bidder shall submit product details / catalog / brochure, wherever applicable.

13. The bidder shall supply the items strictly as per the specifications, quantity and requirements mention ed in the bid. 14. The bidder shall submit acceptance of ATC on their company letterhead. 15. If the bid is submitted from an IP address that matches with the IP address of another bidder / seller or buyer, the bidder will be rejected immediately and will not be evaluated further. . 6. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.
